verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS card-issuing API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of retention settings, data deletion, or redaction for Issuing data. The only nearby item, cards being automatically invalidated after use, is a card-lifecycle control, not data retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
